title: EventBus listener registry mutation during emit contract

correction.previous_behavior: EventBus iterated directly over the mutable listener registry
correction.corrected_behavior: EventBus creates a listener snapshot before event delivery

contract.snapshot_delivery: The current emit uses a stable snapshot of listeners
contract.registry_mutation: Listeners added during emit remain registered but do not receive the current event
contract.delivery_order: Original listeners receive the event in registration order
contract.future_delivery: Newly registered listeners are available for subsequent emits
